subject: planner: integrate Skyline Pruning into index selection of IndexJoin (#63958)
summary: Integrates skyline-pruning candidate comparison into IndexJoin index selection by building an IndexJoin-aware `candidatePath` (including join-key columns that the inner `DataSource` can’t see in `AccessConds`), and adds a regression test for #63949. No remaining Blocker/High correctness, semantics, or runtime issues found in the planner changes.
